blocks.text: LONDON — British comedian and actor Russell Brand appeared in a London court on Monday, Oct. 12. for the start of his trial on rape and sexual assault charges. The hearing at Southwark Crown Court was adjourned until Tuesday after a morning of jury selection. The prosecution is due to open its case later in the week. Brand, who is on bail, left the court building beside the River Thames holding hands with his wife, Laura Gallacher.
